items: Internationalization support. If you see any issues with any of these translations, please let me know!

There is a new map theme chooser! Check it out in the menu -> Map -> Choose Theme. Also, the default dark map has been tweaked to show small roads and paths better. If you liked the old one better, it's still available.
There is now a play/pause/off button for the weather radar on the main screen.
Fix the wind direction arrow not rotating with the map.

If you have any categories in Nearby Places selected, they will start showing automatically when the app starts up. If you want to disable that behaviour, there is a switch on the Nearby Places menu to turn it off.
In-app changelog: view What's New after updates and full history from Help & Info.
You can now see points of interest near your location! Check it out in the Menu->Places.
We've done a big menu refactor to make things easier to find, and easier to manage with gloves on.
A few tiny bug fixes and improvements.
Menu reorganization for easier use with gloves on.
